Man jumps into NSP canal, wife dies by suicide in Khammam
candidates.excerpt: A man jumped into the NSP canal in Khammam in an alleged suicide attempt, while his wife died by suicide at their home in separate incidents. Police launched a search with NDRF assistance, while their two school-going children were left grieving.

candidates.title: All India Majlis Tameer-e-Millat to hold meeting on fall of Hyderabad
candidates.excerpt: The All India Majlis Tameer-e-Millat will organise a public meeting on “Historical Facts of the Fall of Hyderabad” at Khwaja Shouq Hall, Urdu Maskan, on September 17. Majlis president Syed Ayub Hussaini will preside over the meeting.
